title.zh: Cardano 发布 CIP-0113 可编程代币标准，允许发行方冻结、扣押和限制资产
title.en: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets

current_state.zh: Cardano's programmable token standard has gone live, letting issuers define rules that can freeze or force transfers of assets, with wallets, DEXs and lending protocols now needing integration changes to support them.
current_state.en: Cardano's programmable token standard has gone live, letting issuers define rules that can freeze or force transfers of assets, with wallets, DEXs and lending protocols now needing integration changes to support them.

updates.title_en: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
updates.what_changed_zh: The Cardano Foundation released CIP-0113, a token standard that lets issuers of regulated assets like stablecoins, funds and bonds enforce identity and sanctions checks on every transfer and freeze, seize or redirect holdings without a network hard fork.
